Rafael Costa  
Email: rafael.costasolutions@nexatech.com | Phone: +351 912 345 678 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/rafaelcosta | Location: Lisbon, Portugal  

A seasoned data scientist with eight years of experience in crafting enterprise AI solutions that bridge predictive analytics and operational scalability. Specialized in deploying machine learning systems at scale, with a focus on time-series modeling, reinforcement learning, and MLOps infrastructure. Proven ability to translate complex business problems into algorithmic strategies, driving measurable outcomes across financial, healthcare, and technology sectors.

- Optimized NLP models for clinical text analysis, achieving 92% F1-score in entity recognition tasks and reducing manual data curation costs by 30% for healthcare clients.
